entities.summary: Po Rome (?–1651), also spelled Po Romê, Po Romé or Po Ramo, with the Muslim name Nik Mustafa Bin Wan Abul Muzaffar Waliyullah, regnal name Sultan Abdul Hamid Shah, was the king of Panduranga Champa, reigning from 1627 to 1651.
